'''Paramatan fruit tree''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the<ref name="Creatures">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Paramatan]].<ref name="Creatures" />

{{Science-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Paramatan fruit trees were introduced in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]'', published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The section of the book mentioning the trees was written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and illustrated by [[Mike Vilardi]].<ref name="Creatures" />
